description: What is known about the machines behind the results, stated by the person who ran the evaluation. Keyed by machine id: the `machine` of a record's host, which the launcher makes from the CPU model unless EMU_MACHINE names the machine; records made before the id was recorded get the one their CPU model gives. The result records describe each host themselves; this file adds a name for the machine and what records made before the launcher recorded GPUs do not contain. It is not a result record.

intel-core-i7-10700k.machine: PC that starts Linux (Ubuntu 24.04) and Windows, dual boot
